data.name: Sephira
data.gender_notes: Sephira is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sephira is a Hebrew name derived from the biblical Sephirot, the ten divine emanations of God. It is believed to represent the divine feminine, symbolizing wisdom, understanding, and secret knowledge. In Jewish mysticism, Sephira is associated with the goddess Shekhinah and the earthly manifestation of God's presence. The name Sephira carries the meaning “Divine wisdom, secret knowledge” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Sephira usually hope their child will grow to embody divine wisdom, secret knowledge and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sephira total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
